18 of the 19 checks are green on the rebuilt fixture. I didn't re-run any this session; this is from the notes in `tools/handoff/console/notes/53-corpus-reds-b.md` that an earlier run left (it labels itself lane c), plus a check that the alarm entry exists.

- **Fixed:** 17 of the 18 are STALE, so I retargeted each check to keep its intent under the newer rules. Each has a one-line reason in the notes. None of Codex's 22 were touched.
- **v29.33:** the one real game fault. Six raw px sizes in the title and mode rules are now tokens, shipped as v32.87 with no change on screen. The scan covers only the title and mode rules. The rest of the shared block has 58 rules with raw px from later screen ships, so scanning all of it would fail.
- **v28.20:** still red, and it is a real fault. At the default menu zoom of 1.3, the gun key and item wheel names on the stash are cut off. The names are 20px but each tile has only 33–35px of room, and the longest names need 66–69px.
  - **Fix options:** two columns instead of three, or 16px names with the picture hidden on narrow tiles.
  - **Why I left it:** either option changes the stash layout and pad navigation of the tiles, so I didn't pick one blind. It is logged in `tools/handoff/console/alarms.md` for the stash UI lane.
